chrome_hint: Low value, generic lot; only worth checking if a maker stamp appears. eBay AU sold: 'Spear & Jackson digging fork', 'vintage garden fork spade' sold items; Terapeak 'garden tools lot'. Also Gumtree Tasmania garden tools asking prices.
viewing_check: Look for maker stamps on spade/fork blades and sockets (Spear & Jackson, Wilkinson Sword, Bulldog, Tasmanian-made); otherwise nothing. Check for any pre-war or hand-forged tools.
